WITH per_type AS (
  SELECT t.tradekind, COUNT(DISTINCT tr.trdref) AS trader_count
  FROM transactionrecord AS tr
  JOIN trader AS t ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg
  GROUP BY t.tradekind
), stats AS (
  SELECT *,
         SUM(trader_count) OVER () AS total_count,
         AVG(trader_count) OVER () AS avg_count
  FROM per_type
)
SELECT tradekind,
       trader_count,
       CAST(trader_count AS REAL) / total_count AS share_of_total,
       trader_count - avg_count AS above_average
FROM stats
WHERE avg_count IS NOT NULL
  AND trader_count > avg_count;
